title: Expose protocol version through the CLI
summary: Add a covenant version command that probes daemon protocol metadata before authentication so operators and client scripts can detect wire compatibility from the CLI.
expectedFailureModes: Operators can only inspect protocol compatibility through custom IPC or HTTP clients.
The CLI version check accidentally requires an operator token even though protocol_info is safe before authentication.
Live CLI coverage misses the unauthenticated protocol probe path.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant --locked version
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_version -- --ignored live_cli_version_reads_protocol_info_without_token
nextAction: Integrated locally; the next compatibility hardening pass should add stale-client fixtures when protocol version 2 exists.
